fact: The 2023-24 programme-based budget lists developing a new digital geospatial data sharing platform (LAVIMS 2.0) for land transfer, ownership and land registration, with LAVIMS 2.0 Phase 1 and a Digital State Land Register budgeted.
title: Programme-Based Budget 2023-24: Ministry of Housing and Land Use Planning
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Economic Planning and Development, Mauritius
